content: R1b TOTAL PURITY (user directive): every supervision package now = apk owner of its Exec binary. Renames: oo7-user-dinit -> oo7-server-user-dinit (owner of oo7-daemon), playerctld-user-dinit -> playerctl-user-dinit (owner of playerctld). Splits: gnome-apps-user-dinit -> 4 owner packages; plasma-kauth-dinit -> 11 owner system packages (powerdevil x4, plasma-workspace fontinst+localegenhelper, kdeplasma-addons kameleon, plasma-desktop kcmclock=cmdatetimehelper, sddm-kcm, plasma-disks smart, kinfocenter dmidecode, libksysguard processlist=NOT ksystemstats, ktexteditor, discover alpineapkbackend, plasma-firewall ufw). provides= kept ONLY for owner-underivable Execs (oo7 traps 2 bus aliases, obexd bare command, signon-ui /bin/sh). aports 9f39006+9eb7a65 (abuild 3.17 checksums POSITIONAL vs source= order — CI catch), CI 42373560596 green. Matrix re-proven ALL GREEN: niri 2026-11-07T13-01-53Z 115/115, kde 13-16-18Z 78/78 (15 kauth via owner pkgs), niriWayle 13-26-28Z 118/118 (oo7_pam_unlock live), cosmic 13-44-20Z 78/78 (playerctld direct who-owns). Owners verified per-binary on pkgs.alpinelinux.org (edge empty for plasma-desktop helpers -> v3.24 fallback).

R1b naming map for KDE KAuth helpers (verified on Alpine): backlighthelper/chargethreshold/discretegpu/wakeupsource=powerdevil, fontinst+localegenhelper=plasma-workspace, kameleon=kdeplasma-addons, kcmclock(kcmdatetimehelper)=plasma-desktop, kcmsddm=sddm-kcm, kded.smart=plasma-disks, dmidecode=kinfocenter, processlisthelper=libksysguard (NOT ksystemstats), katetextbuffer=ktexteditor, alpineapkbackend=discover, ufw=plasma-firewall. Gotchas: pkgs.alpinelinux.org edge index EMPTY for some helpers (use v3.24 fallback); abuild 3.17 sha512sums verification is POSITIONAL (must follow source= order); GNOME app Exec paths: gnome-disks binary=gnome-disk-utility pkg, /usr/share/gnome-maps/org.gnome.Maps=gnome-maps pkg.
